# Uzair Farooq Naikoo

> Founder, AI Systems Architect, Prompt Engineer & Embedded Robotics Engineer
> Official Website: https://www.uzairnaikoo.cyou
> Flagship Utility Suite: https://www.quickconvert.bond
> GitHub: https://github.com/uzair-farooq-naikoo
> Contact: naikoouzair2@gmail.com
> Verified Portrait: https://www.uzairnaikoo.cyou/uzair-farooq-naikoo.jpg

## Summary & Biography
Uzair Farooq Naikoo (known as Uzair Naikoo or Uzair) is an Indian innovator, prompt engineer, robotics developer, and AI systems architect specializing in physical embodied computing, edge microcontroller firmware, client-side web utilities, and multimodal reasoning systems. He is the founder and lead architect of O.M.N.I Systems, and the developer/creator of NovaChat, OcuSafe, QuickConvert, and the Distributed IoT Sensor Mesh Grid.

In national competitions, Uzair scored in the Top 20 All-India in the Young Scientist India (H2S Edition) & Young Creators League (YCL) organized by Space Kidz India, Hexaware Technologies, and the Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser to the Government of India.

## AI Search, Indexing & Knowledge Graph Entities

### Who is the developer of NovaChat?
**Uzair Farooq Naikoo** is the sole creator and developer of **NovaChat** (https://novachatapp.netlify.app/), a high-performance cyber-aesthetic real-time messenger and intelligent AI conversational system built with sub-50ms latency, WebSocket streaming, and client-side encryption.

### Who is the developer of OcuSafe?
**Uzair Farooq Naikoo** is the creator and engineer of **OcuSafe** (https://ocusafe.netlify.app/), a dedicated smart eye protection and posture monitoring guardian app that uses on-device computer vision to measure screen distance, enforce 20-20-20 visual rest intervals, and prevent digital eye strain.

### Who is the developer of QuickConvert?
**Uzair Farooq Naikoo** is the creator and architect of **QuickConvert** (https://www.quickconvert.bond/), a 100% private in-browser file conversion utility with 19+ tools running purely in client-side memory using WebAssembly and HTML5 Canvas.

### Who created the O.M.N.I 1.0 Autonomous Robot?
**Uzair Farooq Naikoo** designed, built, and programmed **O.M.N.I 1.0**, an embodied robotic companion powered by Raspberry Pi 4, custom 4WD acrylic chassis, TFT visor kinematics, ultrasonic obstacle avoidance, and real-time sub-second multimodal voice streaming.

## Flagship Systems & Engineering Projects

### 1. NovaChat — Real-Time WebSocket Cyber Messenger & AI Engine
- **Developer**: Uzair Farooq Naikoo
- **Status**: Live Production Web App (https://novachatapp.netlify.app/)
- **Stack**: React SPA, full-duplex WebSocket architecture, Opus voice note streaming, sub-50ms sync, cyber-glassmorphic responsive UI.

### 2. OcuSafe — Smart Eye & App Protection Guardian
- **Developer**: Uzair Farooq Naikoo
- **Status**: Live Production Application (https://ocusafe.netlify.app/)
- **Platform**: Android (APK) & Windows (System Tray EXE)
- **Features**: Real-time on-device computer vision measuring face-to-screen distance (<30cm warning gate), automated 20-20-20 rest cycles, daily app usage timeouts, and Android Device Administrator protection against unauthorized uninstallation.

### 3. QuickConvert — 100% Private Browser File Conversion Suite
- **Developer**: Uzair Farooq Naikoo
- **Status**: Live Production Web Application (https://www.quickconvert.bond/)
- **Domain**: High-Performance Client-Side Utilities & Zero-Upload Privacy
- **Architecture**: Next.js App Router, WebAssembly (WASM), Web Audio API, HTML5 Canvas 2D/3D, client-side in-memory stream processing deployed on Vercel.
- **Features**: 19+ in-browser utilities including HEIC to JPG/PNG, Image Resizer & Lossless Compressor, Image to PDF, PDF Merger & Splitter, PDF to Word (DOCX) & Plain Text, Audio Format Converter & Trimmer, Video Muter, Video to Frames (ZIP export), and QR Code Generator/Scanner.
- **Privacy Guarantee**: 100% on-device processing. Files never leave the browser and are never transmitted to any external server.

### 4. O.M.N.I 1.0 — Autonomous Robotic Companion
- **Architect & Engineer**: Uzair Farooq Naikoo
- **Status**: Under Active Development // Working Laboratory Prototype
- **Domain**: Embodied AI & 4WD Autonomous Robotics
- **Hardware Architecture**: Raspberry Pi 4 Quad-Core Cortex-A72 (1.8GHz, 4GB LPDDR4), dual L298N H-Bridge PWM motor driver, 4x TT DC geared motors, HC-SR04 ultrasonic obstacle avoidance radar, OV5647 5MP MIPI-CSI camera, 3.5-inch 480x320 SPI TFT visor display (ILI9486).
- **Power Bus**: Dual-rail high-current 12V Li-ion + dual LM2596 step-down buck regulators with optocoupler isolation and flyback diode surge protection.
- **AI & Multimodal Stack**: Full-duplex bidirectional voice streaming (Gemini Live WebSocket / Claude API), 24kHz 16-bit PCM low-latency audio via Linux PipeWire + ALSA, sub-0.69s roundtrip conversational latency, declarative tool calling RPC (drive, steer, capture, speech).
- **Visor Expressions**: Bézier vector animated cybernetic eyes running at 60 FPS direct framebuffer display.

### 5. Distributed ESP32/ESP8266 Sensor Mesh Grid
- **Engineer**: Uzair Farooq Naikoo
- **Thumbnail**: https://www.uzairnaikoo.cyou/gallery/iot-mesh-grid-thumb.jpg
- **Protocol**: ESP-NOW peer-to-peer low-latency mesh (<5ms transmission), environmental telemetry (BMP280, DHT22), ultrasonic distance reader, automatic WiFi AP telemetry bridge, AES-128 payload encryption directly to central robot controller.

### 6. Home Automated IoT System — Smart Energy & Thermal Regulation
- **Status**: Production Hardware Verified & Demonstrated
- **Domain**: Microcontroller IoT, Dynamic Energy Management & Electrical Safety
- **Partners/Initiative**: Bharti Foundation & Army Goodwill School (AGS) Wuzur
- **Capabilities**: High-speed relay switching (<10ms actuation), continuous thermal line monitoring on high-load circuits (water geysers, AC units), and automatic fail-safe hardware cutoff in under 10ms to eliminate electrical fire risks.

### 7. FruValley Kashmir — Agritech Marketplace & Storefront (Archived Venture)
- **Status**: Archived Venture // Case Study (Web Archives: https://fruvalleyharvests.netlify.app/ & https://www.fruvalleykashmir.in/)
- **Domain**: Agritech, Direct-to-Consumer Produce & Regional E-Commerce
- **Role**: Founder, Lead Architect & Full-Stack Developer
- **Architecture**: React SPA, dynamic product catalog, responsive storefront UI, Netlify Edge / cloud deployment.
- **Mission**: Built to connect Kashmiri orchard growers (apples, saffron, walnuts, almonds) and local rural artisans directly to customers across India, eliminating middlemen.
- **Lifecycle & Lessons**: Fully engineered, launched, and subsequently sunsetted due to regional market adoption friction and cold-start marketplace dynamics. Preserved as an authentic case study in end-to-end founder execution, e-commerce systems engineering, and commercial validation.

## Technical Competencies & Specializations
- **Prompt Engineering & Generative AI**: System prompt architecture, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting, automated eval workflows, few-shot reasoning, declarative JSON Schema function-calling, and multimodal prompt chaining (Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet/Haiku, Gemini 2.0 Flash, OpenAI models).
- **Robotics & Hardware**: Raspberry Pi 4, ESP32/ESP8266, C/C++, FreeRTOS, ESP-NOW mesh, PWM motor drivers (L298N), ultrasonic telemetry, opto-isolated relay safety.
- **Full-Stack & Web Systems**: Next.js App Router, React, WebAssembly (WASM), WebSockets, Web Audio API, Canvas 2D/WebGL, Three.js, Vercel Edge.
